title: 9th Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/9/3/2026).
First reading of the bill to amend the Education Act (Law No. 24/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumeedhoo MP Dr. Anara Naeem.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Goods and Services Tax Act (Law No. 10/2011), submitted on behalf of the government by Kolamaafushi MP Ibrahim Didi.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem calling for full disclosure of the agreement between the government and Eagle Hills on the "Rasmaale" project, to gauge members' views on it.
Report of the Privileges and Conduct Committee on the case of Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir, who was taken into police custody on 11 December 2025 during a fishermen's protest.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to introduce an Education Act amendment, debate a GST amendment and the Rasmaale disclosure resolution, and hear a committee report on an MP detained at a fishermen's protest.
